items.title: 63519_Wild Bill Davison oral history interview
items.q: I told the boss - the Chinese guy - that--- about my wife.

ctx.x: Well, I guess - I should get around to that--- but, anyway, we opened there and it was a marvelous job and, uh, of course, then I surely thought in my mind I could get my wife back - she knew I was doing so good. And, so, I told the boss - the Chinese guy - that--- about my wife. And, he said -- well, I've got a flat -- he said, I keep a woman and he said, she has plenty of room and you and your wife can move in there for the time being anyway -- it won't cost you much. And, I thought that was a marvelous idea.…

and everybody seemed to - at that point - I think, if you tell somebody, you're not allowed to drink -- that's when they're going to drink the most and I think, in those days, even the women were getting drunk, which - you know - and all this---
